intro: Domino's is the world's largest pizza chain, built for fast delivery and the Mix & Match deal, where any two or more items are $6.99 each. Choose Hand Tossed, Crunchy Thin or Handmade Pan crust, load up on specialty pizzas, and add wings, Stuffed Cheesy Bread, pasta and Lava Crunch Cakes. Below is the full Domino's menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A large (14") cheese pizza at Domino's is about $9.99, a medium is $7.99, and specialty pizzas like the MeatZZa run $13.99 to $15.99. The Mix & Match deal gets any 2 or more items (pizza, wings, pasta, sides) for $6.99 each. A medium cheese slice is about 200 calories.
hot_deal: Domino's value: the Mix & Match deal is the headline, any 2 or more items (medium 2-topping pizzas, boneless wings, bread, pasta and more) for $6.99 each. Carryout specials and app deals go lower still. A large cheese pizza is about $9.99. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a large pizza at Domino's?
faqs.a: A large (14") cheese pizza is about $9.99, and large specialty pizzas like the MeatZZa or Deluxe run around $15.99. Adding toppings or premium crusts raises the price.

faqs.q: What is the Mix & Match deal at Domino's?
faqs.a: Mix & Match lets you pick any two or more items for $6.99 each, including medium 2-topping pizzas, boneless chicken, bread sides, pasta and more. It is Domino's main value deal.

faqs.q: What crust types does Domino's have?
faqs.a: Domino's offers Hand Tossed, Crunchy Thin Crust and Handmade Pan on most pizzas, plus New York Style and gluten-free crust on some sizes. Pan crust is thicker and buttery.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a slice of Domino's pizza?
faqs.a: A slice of medium Hand Tossed cheese pizza is about 200 calories. A large slice or one loaded with meat toppings runs higher, often 250 to 350 calories per slice.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Domino's?
faqs.a: The best known are the pepperoni pizza, the MeatZZa, Stuffed Cheesy Bread, boneless chicken, and the Chocolate Lava Crunch Cakes.
